findings.desc: Lattice-Parallel-Development-Capability.md:233-235 and :622-623 introduce a second authority contract instead of reusing the PD-1/PD-2 source vocabulary: the new matrix/report fields use `authorityMode=local/off|shadow|receipt-backed/enforce-capable` and `evidenceClass=...|receipt-backed-authority`, while docs/requirements/decisions/authority-client-role.md:138 and :249-260 define the existing mode/classification terms as `off|shadow|enforce` and `receipt-backed-l2-plus`. The docs-only story correctly preserves the non-authority boundary, but this term drift makes the boundary ambiguous for future implementers and breaks the requested consistency with authority-client-role.
findings.resolvedReason: Resolved by replacing local/off and receipt-backed/enforce-capable wording with the PD-1/PD-2 vocabulary off|shadow|enforce, and by replacing receipt-backed-authority with receipt-backed-l2-plus. Verified with rg that the old terms local/off, receipt-backed-authority, and receipt-backed/enforce are absent.

findings.desc: [MEDIUM] Lattice-Parallel-Development-Capability.md:233, 622-627, 668-685, and 701-703 invent `authorityReceiptRefs` as a required final-report field, while the existing authority surfaces and Parallel Wave docs consistently use the nested `authority.receiptRefs` shape (README.md:333-335, docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-parallel-wave.md:183-184). Without an explicit migration note, this reads as an accidental schema fork and weakens the patch’s format clarity. Fix: either reuse the established `authority.receiptRefs` naming or explicitly define why Parallel Development needs a different schema and how it maps back to the existing authority object.
findings.resolvedReason: Resolved by replacing the invented authorityReceiptRefs field with the established nested authority.receiptRefs shape, and aligning report posture text to authority.receiptVerified, authority.productionDone, authority.authorityChanged, and authority.receiptRefs. Verified with rg and git diff check.
